_comment: Bundle 2B E2E — Drive permissions (share + list_permissions + unshare on both gdocs and gsheets). Workflow: agent creates a doc + a spreadsheet, shares both with a test reader email, lists permissions to confirm the grant landed, then unshares (revokes by permission_id) and lists again to confirm removal. Requires OAuth env (COLMENA_GOOGLE_OAUTH_*) + GEMINI_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL. The test_payload pins `share_email` to daniel@startti.co — change it to a real email you control before running. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/gworkspace_bundle2b_e2e.json --agent-session-id g_b2b_$(date +%s) --include-extra-info`

test_payload.prompt:
Exercise the Bundle 2B permissions surface. Use the email below in every share call:
  SHARE_EMAIL = daniel@startti.co

1. gdocs_create({title: 'Bundle2B Doc <UTC iso>'}). Capture doc_id.
2. gsheets_create_spreadsheet({title: 'Bundle2B Sheet <UTC iso>'}). Capture spreadsheet_id.

3. gdocs_share({doc_id, email: SHARE_EMAIL, role: 'reader'}). Capture permission_id_doc.
4. gsheets_share({spreadsheet_id, email: SHARE_EMAIL, role: 'reader'}). Capture permission_id_sheet.

5. gdocs_list_permissions({doc_id}). Confirm an entry exists with role='reader' and email=SHARE_EMAIL.
6. gsheets_list_permissions({spreadsheet_id}). Confirm an entry exists with role='reader' and email=SHARE_EMAIL.

7. gdocs_unshare({doc_id, permission_id: permission_id_doc}).
8. gsheets_unshare({spreadsheet_id, permission_id: permission_id_sheet}).

9. gdocs_list_permissions({doc_id}). Confirm permission_id_doc is GONE.
10. gsheets_list_permissions({spreadsheet_id}). Confirm permission_id_sheet is GONE.

Final report (<200 words): for each numbered step report the result + PASS/FAIL. Include both resource IDs and both permission_ids that were grant/revoked.

config.system_message: You are testing the colmena Bundle 2B permissions tools. Use ONLY the listed tool names. If a tool returns an error, report it verbatim and stop.
